title: Asooka Okunoonya Okusonyiyibwa
intro: Ddayo mu kiseera ng’enjuba tennavaayo esooka, ng’omuntu yenna afa tannatambula ku nsi. Ekifaananyi kyakolebwanga okuva mu bintu ebisinga obuwombeefu, ne kiweebwa ekifo waggulu wa bamalayika, ne kiteekebwa mu lusuku olutukuvu nga waliwo okulabula okutegeerekeka. Naye mu kaseera kamu, okulonda kwakolebwa — okwandizzeemu okuwulikika mu byafaayo by’omuntu byonna. Ffiga eno y’ani?
clues: Naleetebwa mu ngeri etafaananako ndala yonna — nakolebwa okuva mu nfuufu y’ensi era ne nweebwa emmeeme ennamu omukono gw’Omutonzi.
Nnaweebwa okumanya okw’amaanyi ennyo ne kiba nti ne bamalayika abali waggulu baakwewuunya.
Bonna ab’omu ggulu baalagirwa okufukamira mu maaso gange, era bonna ne bagondera — okuggyako omu, eyagaana olw’amalala.
Nateekebwa mu lusuku olutukuvu, ekifo eky’okubudaabudibwa n’okugabirira emirembe gyonna — naye nga kirimu okuwera okumu okukakali.
Neerabira, naseerera, era nejeema — era nawulira obuzito bw’ensobi yange nnyo.
Nakyukira Mukama wange n’ebigambo ebiva ku mutima, era n’akkiriza okwenenya kwange, kubanga y’asinga okusonyiwa.

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful. (2:37)
